summary: Specifies WebDAV SEARCH, a set of methods, headers, and properties that add searching to HTTP-based WebDAV. A client sends search criteria and the server returns matching resources, so the client does not have to fetch and scan everything itself. It is on the standards track.

eli5.summary: A big shared folder on a website is hard to look through by hand. This lets you ask the server to search it for you and give back just the matching files.
